about.heading: About
about.mainTitle: A small collection of writing — on code, craft, and culture.
about.intro: I'm **Jérémie Corpinot** — the sole developer and writer of this site. I build the platform and write the posts, focusing on technical depth and cultural perspective.
about.description: This space is intentionally small — fewer, better pieces. Expect practical guides, essays, and recommendations that bridge engineering and the arts.
about.openSourceText: The full source code is available on **GitHub**. Issues, PRs, or design suggestions are welcome — see the repository for contribution guidelines.
about.faqWhoContent: I do — I'm the sole developer and writer: Jérémie Corpinot. I handle code, publishing, and site design.
about.faqTopicsLabel: What topics do you write about?
about.faqTopicsContent: Mostly technology, development and programming. I also write about art and culture — films, books, and podcasts that influence my thinking.
about.faqOpenSourceContent: Yes — the project is open source on GitHub: github.com/rootasjey/corpinot
about.faqContributeLabel: Can I contribute or pitch a post?
about.faqContributeContent: Yes. Open a GitHub issue or send a short pitch to hello@corpinot.cc. I'm particularly interested in practical, experience-driven pieces.
about.faqNewsletterContent: Yes — subscribe for weekly highlights and occasional deep dives.
about.metaDescription: About Jérémie Corpinot — developer, writer, and creator of Corpinot.
about.contactText: Questions, pitches, or bugs? Email hello@corpinot.cc
